description: Detects geographic anomalies by identifying accounts transacting from multiple countries within a short time window — a common indicator of account takeover or card fraud.

configuration.query: FROM fraud-workshop* | WHERE @timestamp >= ?startTime AND @timestamp <= ?endTime | STATS country_count=COUNT_DISTINCT(wire.outbound.country_code), tx_count=COUNT(*), total_amount=SUM(event.amount) BY account.name | WHERE country_count >= ?minCountries | SORT country_count DESC | LIMIT ?limit

startTime.description: Start of the time window in ISO 8601 format

endTime.description: End of the time window in ISO 8601 format

minCountries.description: Minimum number of distinct countries to flag an account. Defaults to 2.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 25.
